heading: Monday, January 20, 2025
topLine: 2 model releases: DeepSeek-R1 and Moonshot AI Kimi k1.5.

items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-R1 reasoning model
items.summary: DeepSeek-R1 is an open-weight reasoning model (671B total, 37B active parameters, MoE) that DeepSeek says performs comparably to OpenAI o1 on math, code and reasoning tasks. Weights are MIT-licensed, alongside six distilled dense models (1.5B–70B) based on Qwen2.5 and Llama, and it is available via the web app and the API as deepseek-reasoner.

items.headline: Moonshot AI releases Kimi k1.5 reasoning model
items.summary: Kimi k1.5 is a multimodal model trained with large-scale reinforcement learning, with long-chain-of-thought and short-chain-of-thought modes. Moonshot claims long-CoT results matching OpenAI o1 on benchmarks such as AIME, MathVista and Codeforces; a technical report was published, but no weights.
